investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lumcrest Trips (travel booking); Platform: Google Cloud us-central1 (zones us-central1-a/us-central1-b/us-central1-c/us-central1-f); network range 10.202.0.0/16; Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic loyalty-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer loyalty-api, consumer search-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
